# free-for.dev

Developers and open-source authors now have many services offering free tiers.

**NOTE**: This list is only for as-a-Service offerings.

# Table of Contents

## Major Cloud Providers

  * [Example Cloud](https://example.com)
    * Compute - 1 free micro instance per month
    * [Object Storage](https://example.com/storage) - 5GB free, 1GB egress
  * [Another Cloud](https://another.example)
    * Database - 1GB free

## Email

  * [Mailer](https://mailer.example) - 100 emails per day

## Other Free Resources

  * Plain Service - 10 requests per month, no link at all
